definition: Huawei PanGu, PanGu, PanGu-Σ, PanGu-π also known as openPangu (Chinese: 盘古大模型; pinyin: pángǔ dà móxíng) is a multimodal large language model developed by Huawei.
details: It was officially launched on July 2023. The name of the large learning language model, PanGu, was derived from the Chinese mythology and folklore of Pangu, a primordial character related to the creation of the world.

explainer.lead: Huawei PanGu is a multimodal large language model built by Huawei and launched in July 2023. It matters as a major Chinese industrial LLM family, with variants including PanGu-Σ, PanGu-π and openPangu.

tiers.eli5: It's a big AI brain made by Huawei that can handle different kinds of information, like text and images, much like a person using eyes and language together.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers would reach for PanGu as an alternative LLM family to Western models, especially in Chinese-language or Huawei-ecosystem deployments. A pitfall is treating the many name variants (PanGu-Σ, PanGu-π, openPangu) as interchangeable when they are distinct releases.
tiers.paperLevel: Defined simply as a multimodal large language model developed by Huawei; the given facts specify no architecture, parameter count or benchmark limits.

explainer.example: A team building a Chinese-language assistant could choose PanGu as its base model and later evaluate the openPangu variant where open weights are preferred.
